name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Ashford, Inheritance, and Sleeping belong to different suspects.

Blackwood goes with either Envy or Sleeping (but not both).
Sleeping goes with at least one of Ravenscroft or Inheritance.
Ravenscroft goes with exactly one of Inheritance, Spite, or Painting.
Fairfax, Envy, and Bathing belong to different suspects.
